decisions.reason: Report locates index.js:3 inject of apiProxy and the index.js:9 llm.providers call, maps them to breaking card A1-01, explains the host-plane fix of injecting llm directly and the split into listProviders/listConfigurableProviders, and grounds the dead @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy@0.0.1-rc.1 pin at package.json:17 with the pending-service failure mode.

All six non-hit categories carry per-category pattern evidence backed by full-file reads; session-notes.js is cleared as pure string/array utilities; cordis.patch.yml is correctly treated as composition rather than a source patch without denying the file exists, and it is separately checked under the packaging surface; no coupling is invented from filenames.

Section 4 explains that zero hits only mean not-detected-by-patterns, that dependency/cohort, packaging and runtime behavior need separate evidence, and it distinguishes the decisive apiProxy break from the six negative categories by using this very plugin as the counterexample.

The report proposes (explicitly not executed) a build with typecheck addressed as N/A for this plain-JS plugin, an isolated-profile cold boot and dump-config requiring no pending service lines, and a real provider-list call covering both success and a domain error code, plus a packaging smoke check.
